scope: Actual positive primitive six-speed vectors of value at most 1/6 have Euclidean norm below 21829, assuming the explicit containing-plane gap 2/11 and four-speed runner bound. A reduced integral basis, all Gram-prefix inequalities and the determinant identity are constructed internally. This component does not itself prove that off-critical vectors satisfy the plane-gap premise, nor does it assert the arbitrary rational-subspace covolume lemma or exhaustive six-speed classification.
